heading: INT. VANTAGEPOINT SYNERGIES - OPEN OFFICE - DAY

units.text: INT. VANTAGEPOINT SYNERGIES - OPEN OFFICE - DAY
A sea of gray cubicles under a banner reading "WE ARE FAMILY."
A dead plant guards the water cooler.
GORDON PRYCE, 50s, regional VP, stands on a swivel chair with a megaphone, delivering a speech.
SHANICE WHITLOCK, 30s, sits at her desk eating yogurt and not looking up.
ANIL DESHPANDE, 40s, mouthing the words, nods along without hearing them.
BETTINA KROL, 50s, in a cardigan, sorts staples by size.
FITZ MORIARTY, 20s, an intern, takes photos for the company newsletter.
Team! I have an announcement!
units.name: GORDON

units.text: Is it a layoff?
units.name: SHANICE

units.text: It's a realignment.
units.name: GORDON

units.text: It's a layoff.
units.name: ANIL

units.text: It is a strategic pivot toward efficiency!
units.name: GORDON

units.text: Bettina picks up the stapler and stacks three boxes in a neat pyramid.
Fitz steps onto a desk for a better angle and loses his balance, then rights himself and fires off a flash straight into Gordon's eyes.
Gordon staggers, flailing the megaphone, and Anil catches his chair as it rolls.
Mr. Pryce. Corporate would like a word.
units.name: MS. OYEWOLE

units.text: Now?
units.name: GORDON

units.text: Now, Gordon.
units.name: MS. OYEWOLE

units.text: Gordon climbs down, handing the megaphone to Fitz, who points it at Bettina, who points the stapler back at him.
Shanice finally lifts her head, spoon halfway to her mouth.
Is that about us?
units.name: SHANICE

units.text: It's about him.
units.name: MS. OYEWOLE

units.text: Anil bursts into a coughing laugh.
Gordon straightens his tie and walks toward the elevator, shoulders sagging.
Poor Gordon.
units.name: BETTINA

units.text: He'll be fine.
units.name: SHANICE

units.text: He won't.
units.name: ANIL

units.text: I got a great shot of it.
units.name: FITZ
